explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/500: 'What is ex_3(n, K_4^3)? That is, the largest number of 3-edges which can be placed on n vertices so that there exists no K_4^3, a set of 4 vertices covered by all 4 possible 3-edges.' The Lean statement is a value question equating n ↦ Hypergraph.cliqueExtremalNumber n 3 4 with erdos_500.answer : ℕ → ℕ. cliqueExtremalNumber n 3 4 is the maximum cardinality of a family of 3-subsets of Fin n not satisfying ContainsCompleteHypergraph 3 4, i.e. with no 4-set S all of whose 3-subsets are edges — exactly ex_3(n, K_4^3). Faithful.
